notes.title: Giga-Patch 1.1.6
notes.notes:
Hello!
This update is probably the last major content addition to the game, and focuses on enhancing the player experience:

- Added a brand new Pinboard interface, on which you may rearrange gathered clues, as well as tag them as true, false, and plausible. This interface is accessible via clicking on the, uh, pinboard in your office and replaces the old, list-based interface

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43373986/15cd99d8ee60ea41d7170ddb9e7594dc019556eb.png

- Added a brand new City Map interface that's used for navigating between available scenes. This interface replaces the old and boring list of available locations, and is accessible through walking to the current scene exit, or pressing TAB.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43373986/a02c58f3f93240d2974a2e0edbcce8efe40ced13.png

- Expanded the save system, so that apart from an autosave in each scene, the game creates a separate savefile at the beginning of each day. When loading game from the menu, you can now choose the savefile to load. 

- Changed the way tutorial popups work, so that they disappear only after walking away from their trigger, not after a set amount of time (so you don't have to worry about not reading them in time!)

- Changed the highlight colour of dialogue options, for better contrast and visibility, as well as...

- ...Implemented the option to browse available dialogue option using navigation keys (you can select a highlighted option via E, Enter, or Space)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43373986/cd542226815571c51884088a38d9cc5862bbc282.png

- Fixed some mistakes in text

- Replaced in-game references to No █████ ████████ with No Questions Asked.

Thank you for all the suggestions and bug-hunting! This update largely came to be because of your feedback

Cheers

notes.title: Hotfix to the last patch
notes.notes:
- made sure audio setting should default to full
- adapted the elevator & packages interactions so that they can be done without clicking on them (a leftover from when the game was solely mouse-controlled)
- tweaked one minor interaction at Tobey's

notes.title: Patch 1.1.4 is out now!
notes.notes:
Hi! Some work has been done:
- Added keyboard controls (wsad and arrows) to navigate in-scenes
- Added the option to quickly pop up scene transition menu (by pressing TAB), if it's possible to leave the current scene (and added a notification if it's not)
- Tweaked some camera panning zone options
- Added game logo to the credits, cause we just now realized it wasn't already there

Cheerio!

notes.title: Bugfixes and QoL additions (1.1.3)!
notes.notes:
- Fixed some issues with clue object interactions that led to possible endless dialogue finish button generation
- Added the possibility to close dialogue window / advance dialogue (if there's only one dialogue choice available); just press spacebar or click anywhere on the screen that's not a button!

notes.title: Quick patch 1.1.2!
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where unpausing the game might have, ironically, frozen the game.

Cheers
